people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Shechem
people.line: Founded the city where Dinah was raped

translations.web: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
translations.bsb: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
translations.asv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
